query: Automotive displays Taiwan United States import duties

statements.text: Under the U.S.–Taiwan trade framework announced on January 15, tariffs on goods imported from Taiwan, including automotive parts, will be capped at no more than 15 percent.

This notice amends the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) to implement the terms of the MOU pertaining to the modification of certain Section 232 tariffs applied to automobile parts, timber, lumber, and wood derivative products of Taiwan.

Parts of passenger vehicles and light trucks that are products of Taiwan as provided for in subdivisions (r) and (u) of U.S. note 33 to this subchapter, with an ad valorem (or ad valorem equivalent as provided for in subdivision (m) of U.S. note 33 to this subchapter) rate of duty under column 1—General or column 1—Special less than 15 percent

In the MOU, the United States committed, in part, to limit the Section 232 duties applied to certain automobile parts, timber, lumber, and wood derivative products of Taiwan to no more than 15 percent.
